info.name: SIDIS – Entrega 2 Modo A (IntelliJ)
info.description:
AISafe Entrega 2, Mode A (IntelliJ): Airports & Routes (8091-8093) and Flight Operations (8081-8083), plus Aircraft (8071-8073) for the aircraft lookups + local Keycloak and NGINX gateway (8443) for login, as in the Entrega 1 Mode A collection.
Extra requirement: RabbitMQ on localhost:5672: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.services.yml up -d rabbitmq (user aisafe / password aisafe-mq). In the 3 'Airports - Instância N' Run Configurations add SPRING_RABBITMQ_USERNAME=aisafe and SPRING_RABBITMQ_PASSWORD=aisafe-mq.
Flight Operations: one PostgreSQL per instance on localhost:5441/5442/5443 (db/user/password flightops); in each 'FlightOperationsApplication - Instance N' Run Configuration set DB_URL=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:544N/flightops.
Use with the SIDIS environment (ar1, ar2, ar3, gateway, realm, clientId, pwd*). Turn off SSL verification.
Reads between instances carry X-P2P-Hops: 1 (no forwarding), so a 200 proves the event arrived through RabbitMQ.
Folders 00 to 07: automatic (Runner, 100 ms delay). Folders 08, 09 and 10: manual. RabbitMQ management API: collection variables mqMgmt, mqUser, mqPassword (Mode A development credentials). FO checks call fo1, fo2 and fo3 directly, in turn, so each one covers the 3 replicas.

exec: // Poll one instance until `n` consecutive answers satisfy `pred`. X-P2P-Hops: 1 turns forwarding off, so a good
// answer means the event really reached THAT instance through RabbitMQ.
const until = async (inst, role, path, pred, o = {}) => {
const n = o.n || 2, end = Date.now() + (o.ms || 30000); let ok = 0, last;
last = await L.call('GET', path, null, role, pm.environment.get(inst), HOP);

item.name: 05.07 Concurrency: 8 simultaneous bookings of the same slot, spread over the 3 instances, converge to exactly one flight {NONE}

exec: const base = Date.UTC(2031 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8), Math.floor(Math.random() * 12), 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 25));
// Calls go straight to the FO instances, in turn (fo1, fo2, fo3, fo1, ...), so every check covers all 3 replicas.
let _n = 0; const C = (m, p, b, role) => L.call(m, p, b, role, FO[(_n++) % FO.length]);
const asList = j => Array.isArray(j) ? j : (j && j._embedded ? [].concat(...Object.values(j._embedded)) : []);

const one = i => L.send({url: FO[i % FO.length] + '/api/scheduled-flights', method: 'POST', header: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + tk}, body: {mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({routeId: 'RT-OPOLIS', registrationNumber: 'CS-TTA', scheduledDateTime: slot + ':00'})}});
const res = await Promise.all(Array.from({length: 8}, (_, i) => one(i)));
const codes = res.map(r => r.code); console.log('codes', JSON.stringify(codes));
pm.test('8 simultaneous bookings of CS-TTA for the same slot: only 201 or 409 (' + codes.join(',') + ')', () => codes.forEach(c => pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(c)));
pm.test('At most one booking accepted per instance (3 instances) (row lock on the aircraft)', () => pm.expect(codes.filter(c => c === 201).length).to.be.within(1, 3));

for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) { const r = await C('GET', '/api/scheduled-flights/aircraft/CS-TTA', null, 'ATCC'); const at = asList(r.code === 200 ? r.json() : []).filter(f => String(f.scheduledDateTime).startsWith(slot)); alive = at.filter(f => f.status !== 'CANCELED'); const canceled = at.filter(f => f.status === 'CANCELED'); if (alive.length === 1 && canceled.every(f => /^SCHEDULE_CONFLICT_WITH/.test(f.statusReason || ''))) { seen++; if (seen >= 4) break; } else seen = 0; await L.sleep(500); }

pm.test('After convergence, exactly ONE flight remains at ' + slot + ' on every replica (double booking compensated)', () => { pm.expect(alive.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(seen).to.be.at.least(4); });

item.name: 05.08 Out-of-order event: a stale FlightStatusChanged (revision 1) is ignored by all 3 instances {NONE}

exec: // Calls go straight to the FO instances, in turn (fo1, fo2, fo3, fo1, ...), so every check covers all 3 replicas.

pm.test('Precondition: the flight is DELAYED at revision 2 (05.03)', () => { pm.expect(cur.status).to.eql('DELAYED'); pm.expect(cur.revision).to.eql(2); });

const flight = {flightId: id, routeId: cur.routeId, registrationNumber: cur.registrationNumber, scheduledDateTime: cur.scheduledDateTime, actualDepartureDateTime: null, actualArrivalDateTime: null, status: 'SCHEDULED', statusReason: null, revision: 1, lastModifiedAt: '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z', createdAt: '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z', originInstance: 'postman'};

const event = {eventId: eid, type: 'FlightStatusChanged', version: 1, occurredAt: '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z', aggregateId: id, revision: 1, sourceInstance: 'postman', correlationId: eid, payload: {previousStatus: 'DELAYED', flight}};

const p = await L.send({url: MG + '/api/exchanges/%2F/flights.events/publish', method: 'POST', header: {Authorization: AUTH, 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: {mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({properties: {content_type: 'application/json', message_id: eid}, routing_key: 'flight.status-changed', payload: JSON.stringify(event), payload_encoding: 'string'})}});
pm.test('Stale FlightStatusChanged (revision 1, SCHEDULED) published to all 3 instances', () => pm.expect(p.json().routed).to.eql(true));
for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const r = await C('GET', '/api/scheduled-flights/' + id, null, 'ATCC'); reads.push(r.json()); }

pm.test('Out-of-order event is ignored on all 3 instances: still DELAYED, revision 2 (last-writer-wins by revision)', () => reads.forEach(j => { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('DELAYED'); pm.expect(j.revision).to.eql(2); }));

item.name: 05.09 Rapid command sequence across the 3 instances (DELAYED → IN_FLIGHT → COMPLETED) converges {NONE}

exec: // Calls go straight to the FO instances, in turn (fo1, fo2, fo3, fo1, ...), so every check covers all 3 replicas.
let _n = 0; const C = (m, p, b, role) => L.call(m, p, b, role, FO[(_n++) % FO.length]);
const r0 = await C('POST', '/api/scheduled-flights', {routeId: 'RT-OPOLIS', registrationNumber: 'CS-TTA', scheduledDateTime: pm.environment.get('p2day3') + 'T11:00:00'}, 'ATCC');

for (const s of steps) { let r; for (let k = 0; k < 15; k++) { r = await C('PATCH', '/api/scheduled-flights/' + id + '/status', {status: s}, 'ATCC'); if (r.code === 200) break; await L.sleep(300); } pm.test('Command ' + s + ' accepted by one of the replicas (200)', () => pm.expect(r.code).to.eql(200)); }

for (let k = 0; k < 30; k++) { last = []; for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const r = await C('GET', '/api/scheduled-flights/' + id, null, 'ATCC'); if (r.code === 200) last.push(r.json()); } if (last.length === 6 && last.every(j => j.status === 'COMPLETED') && new Set(last.map(j => j.revision)).size === 1) break; await L.sleep(500); }

pm.test('Rapid command sequence converges: all 3 instances show COMPLETED with the same revision', () => { pm.expect(last.length).to.eql(6); pm.expect(last.every(j => j.status === 'COMPLETED')).to.be.true; pm.expect(new Set(last.map(j => j.revision)).size).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('A COMPLETED flight cannot be canceled on any replica (409)', () => pm.expect(fin.code).to.eql(409));

exec: // Calls go straight to the FO instances, in turn (fo1, fo2, fo3, fo1, ...), so every check covers all 3 replicas.
